⚠️ (B) definition mismatch

SPEC:
Plot delta R between the leading lepton and the closest b-jet

CODE:
helper_delta_r(lepton, bjet) -> min_dr -> dr_lepton_bjet_list; 〔L362-L368〕

Reason:
The code computes the delta R between the leading lepton and each b-jet, then takes the minimum. However, the SPEC requires the delta R between the leading lepton and the closest b-jet, which is correctly implemented. No mismatch detected.

Evidence priority:
〔L362-L368〕

Generator bias:
none

◎ (correct implementation)

Reason:
The code correctly builds the hadronic W candidate by summing the four-momenta of the two leading non-b-tagged jets.
